description: Control a watch through OpenVibe.Watch's control API (ADR-048, plan T13 step 10): POST /api/v1/resources/control takes one common.resource-control-request@1 naming a watch.watch by its OVRN, from a first-party service (OpenVibe.Services) acting for the person in on_behalf_of. Actions: suspend (pause the watch: nothing is checked until it resumes), resume (active again) and delete (remove it, as DELETE /api/v1/watches/:id); any other action is refused unsupported. Only the watch's owner may act on it, and only inside the project the OVRN names. dry_run decides and explains without applying. The first answer per (caller, project, idempotency_key) is kept and returned for a repeat; the same key with another request is refused. Answers common.resource-control-result@1.
